name: Michael Gin
story: Michael Gin worked in Auckland Council’s geospatial team during the GFMO and GeoMaps programme and is shown in GBS material with the team’s Esri Special Achievement in GIS award. He later joined Geographic Business Solutions as Solutions Manager after more than fifteen years in geospatial work, including substantial local-government experience.
